companyFieldUpdates.description: Aligned Data Centers develops and operates hyperscale and build-to-suit data center campuses for cloud, AI, high-performance-computing and enterprise customers. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Dallas, the platform reported 51 campuses and more than 6.4 GW of operational and planned capacity across the United States and Latin America at the July 2026 transaction closing. On July 21, 2026, an AI Infrastructure Partnership consortium led by Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX completed its acquisition of 100% of Aligned at an enterprise value of approximately US$40 billion. GIP/GIM and MGX are the current joint controllers; their exact percentages and underlying fund allocations are not publicly disclosed. Macquarie Asset Management-managed funds and Mubadala were direct owners before the closing and are preserved as former owners. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent, AIP only as the investment program and Mubadala only as an indirect parent of MGX. No later ownership transfer or signed exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
